# Security Policy

This repository powers the public website for the Great American Coin & Collectibles Show (GACC).

## Reporting a security concern

Please report security vulnerabilities privately to **gaccshow@gmail.com** with the subject **GACC Website Security Report**. Include a concise description, the affected page or feature, steps to reproduce without accessing other people's data, and a way to contact you.

**Do not** post vulnerabilities, passwords, customer information, payment information, or secret keys in public GitHub issues. Do not attempt to access real dealer or subscriber records or run disruptive tests.

We will review legitimate reports as resources permit. Do not assume the absence of a reply means your report was ignored.

## Payment safety

The current website is a public information and dealer application site. The dealer application does not collect online payments. Do not enter full card numbers, CVV/CVC, bank account details, passwords or Social Security numbers in the dealer application or email.

Any future checkout implementation must use an established hosted payment provider, with sensitive payment data handled by that provider. Secret API keys must never be committed to this public repository.

## Scope

Website source is public. Account, DNS, hosting, email provider, and payment provider configuration are managed separately and are not verified merely because the website source checks pass.
